title: People and groups
sub: The fifth film of Locks before the data, the first series of Data protection and privacy, and its first tool film: a key that ends with the stay, as the hotels' card locks of the 1970s made theirs. Microsoft Entra ID's people and groups read by Azure Databricks at the account, each workspace given groups, never people, so a move or a departure needs nothing on the platform; one sign-in, with a passkey no fake page can catch, after the confidentiality agreement; admin power in groups no one is in, switched on with privileged identity management for a task and off again; the command line signing in through the browser, and personal tokens turned off.
howto: The film is drawn in the module's look, Night glass: a dark hall of frosted panes, with cards of frosted glass and bright rims. Cyan is an identity, green allowed, coral denied or closed, amber admin power switched on, gold the chip of a sealed token. The tools' pages are drawn, not filmed, each with its official logo and full name. The hotels of the 1970s are painted in the same night light, with their place and year on a tag.
